community_benchmarks.author: Dariush Afshar
community_benchmarks.title: Combine Tracking Audit: Speed r=0.95, Start r=0.28
community_benchmarks.findings: Proves top speed repeats (r=0.95) but tracking start has high noise (r=0.28) except for DL (r=0.65-0.92). Weight explains 84% of raw DL burst vs get-off.

community_benchmarks.author: Yumeko Hata
community_benchmarks.title: DB Drills Decoded: CB/S Tracking + 2024 Data Trap
community_benchmarks.findings: Identified 2024 backpedal drill truncation (6.0s vs 11.6s) and unquantized 2025 sensor grid. Proved need for (drill, year) centering.
